lines.zh: 我提着灯，沿石阶往下走。
lines.en: I carry my lantern down the stone steps.

lines.zh: 长袍下摆扫过潮湿的地面。
lines.en: My robe hem sweeps the damp floor.
I count the steps as I go.

lines.zh: 我在巡查这一带的怪物。
lines.en: I patrol this district for monsters.
Iron taps against my hip.

lines.zh: 我推开一扇木门，门轴在响。
lines.en: I push a wooden door; its hinge complains.
I step around the standing water.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像走过很多次。
lines.en: My pace is steady, as if walked many times.

lines.zh: 我把灯举高，照前面的路。
lines.en: I lift the lantern to light the way.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有声音，我加快脚步。
lines.en: A sound at the corridor's end; I quicken.

lines.zh: 我在门口的阴影里停了一下。
lines.en: I pause in the doorway's shadow.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩碎了什么，很脆。
lines.en: Something brittle breaks under my boot.

lines.zh: 我把灯放在脚边，歇一歇。
lines.en: I set the lantern down and rest.
I murmur a passage of prayer.

lines.zh: 手指在胸口画了个记号。
lines.en: My fingers trace a sign on my chest.

lines.zh: 这地方太安静，安静得可疑。
lines.en: Too quiet here. Suspiciously so.

lines.zh: 我检查了一遍护腕的扣带。
lines.en: I check the straps on my bracer.
The flame shivers in the lantern.

lines.zh: 我把背靠在墙上，听外面。
lines.en: I set my back to the wall and listen.
I am thinking of what my senior said.
The lamp oil is running low.

lines.zh: 我用袖子擦了擦额头的湿气。
lines.en: I wipe the damp from my brow with a sleeve.

lines.zh: 墙上的海嗣痕迹还很新。
lines.en: The seaborn marks on the wall are fresh.
I lay my weapon across my knees.
I look up at the vault. Too high.
I count the tinder sticks left.

lines.zh: 远处传来水声，一直在响。
lines.en: Water sounds somewhere, never stopping.
I stand; my knees are stiff.
You are not of this order. Hold.
I raise the lantern to your face.

lines.zh: 我提着灯，在审判庭巡夜。
lines.en: Lamp in hand, I patrol for the court.
Take your hand off your weapon.

lines.zh: 我在判断你受没受侵染。
lines.en: I am judging whether you are tainted.
Your eyes are still your own.
Good. Then pass.
I will not ask where you came from.

lines.zh: 这条走廊往下的路封了。
lines.en: The way down this corridor is closed.

lines.zh: 你要下去，我不拦，但别回来求我。
lines.en: Go down if you must. Do not come back begging.

lines.zh: 我把灯举到你面前，让你看清我。
lines.en: I hold the lantern up so you see me clearly.

lines.zh: 我是审判庭的见习修士。
lines.en: I am an acolyte of the Inquisition.
Why do you laugh? There is nothing funny.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有泥，从下面来的。
lines.en: Mud on your boots. You came from below.

lines.zh: 我倒吸一口气，退到墙边。
lines.en: I gasp and retreat to the wall.
My armor took part of it.
Blood drips on my prayer text and blurs it.
I press the wound and say a word.
The lantern swings hard; I steady it.
The pain whites out my sight.
My breathing is off.
I cannot fall yet.

lines.zh: 我把受伤的手换到后面。
lines.en: I put the hurt arm behind me.

lines.zh: 法袍破了一道，我还能站。
lines.en: My robe is torn, but I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我不吃巡查时给的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what is offered on patrol.
You hold it out; I shake my head.
Keep it. I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，又看回黑暗。
lines.en: One glance at it, then back to the dark.
That is against the order's rules.
I push your hand gently back.
Water I would take.

lines.zh: 我现在只想把这段路走完。
lines.en: I want only to finish this stretch.
Keep it. You will need it more on the road.
I step back to refuse.
You bump me and the lantern swings.
I brace on the wall and steady myself.
Do not walk abreast in a corridor.

lines.zh: 我推开木门，也推开了你。
lines.en: I push the wooden door open, and you with it.

lines.zh: 我的护肩碰到你，是铁的。
lines.en: My pauldron catches you. It is iron.
Careful. The floor tiles are loose.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，重新提好灯。
lines.en: I step back and settle the lantern.
A small collision. Nothing more.
Go ahead. I will light the way.
Do not jostle me again. The oil will spill.
I have taken a vow. Not this.
The Inquisition has no families.
I leave such words outside the door.
Lamp oil burns shorter than vows.
I do not look her way.
My road goes below, deep.
Someone will remember my name.

lines.zh: 我把手放在灯罩上，暖的。
lines.en: I lay a hand on the lamp housing. It is warm.
Such thoughts must be pressed down.
I walk on.
I bend and pocket it.
This may be a clue.
There is seaborn slime on it.
I pick it up wrapped in cloth.
Not mine. I put it back.
This is useful. I keep it.
You dropped it. Keep it safe.
I examine it under the lantern.
Filthy, but it must come with me.
I slip it into my ledger.
Something moves behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我把灯压低，光收成一束。
lines.en: I lower the lantern and narrow the light.
Those are not human footsteps.
I draw my weapon.
It is bigger than any I have seen.
I speak a short prayer.
Less than ten paces.

lines.zh: 我把背靠住墙，不留空隙。
lines.en: I put my back to the wall, no gap.
It is testing my limits.
Then let it try its fill.
The Inquisition does not retreat.
I raise my weapon and step to meet it.
I close on it step by step.
Its joints bend the wrong way.
I watch its forelimbs.

lines.zh: 它每绕一步，我的灯就跟上。
lines.en: With each step it circles, my lantern follows.
I raise the lantern to dazzle it.
Its hide is wet in the light.
I wait for it to lunge first.
Water on the floor. It will be slick.
I give half a step and reset my stance.
Its breathing is loud.
It cannot hold this passage.
Only three steps remain.
My weapon comes to shoulder height.

lines.zh: 我一记横斩劈在它身上。
lines.en: I cut across it with one stroke.
It recoils, fluid spattering the wall.
I catch its claw on my bracer.
I press in and give it no breath.
It is taller, but I am steadier.
I strike its joint.

lines.zh: 它歪了一下，我补上第二下。
lines.en: It lurches; I follow with a second.
My arm is ringing from it.
The prayer has not stopped in my mouth.
I drive it toward the water.

lines.zh: 我在这条走廊里醒来，肩靠着墙。
lines.en: I wake in this corridor, shoulder to the wall.
The lantern is by my hand, still lit.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是从下面被追上来的。
lines.en: I remember being chased up from below.

lines.zh: 我把衣服上的黏液刮掉。
lines.en: I scrape the slime from my clothes.

lines.zh: 这里不是审判庭的驻地。
lines.en: This is not an Inquisition post.

lines.zh: 我数了数武器，一件没少。
lines.en: I count my weapons. Nothing missing.

lines.zh: 我抬手敲了敲墙壁，是实的。
lines.en: I knock the wall. Solid.

lines.zh: 我在心里默念了一段誓词。
lines.en: I recite a vow silently.

lines.zh: 脚下有水，不知道从哪来。
lines.en: Water underfoot, of unknown source.
I stand and find my line of retreat.
Wind comes in from somewhere.
I loop the lamp cord around my wrist.
I am alive. So I continue.
May the lamp light my road.

lines.zh: 火苗窜上袍角，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame climbs my robe; two slaps put it out.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，滚到了底。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and roll to the bottom.

lines.zh: 海水灌进嘴里，我抓着石头往上。
lines.en: Seawater floods my mouth; I claw up the stone.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，灯脱手了。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and the lamp leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 一根骨刺扎进我的肩膀。
lines.en: A bone spike lodges in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 有什么东西钻进我的脑子，很冷。
lines.en: Something enters my mind, cold.
Too long hungry; my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我的骨头都震了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my bones rattle.

lines.zh: 脚下的砖不见了，我往下掉。
lines.en: The tiles vanish and I drop.
